title: Puttering Pebblepus
statement: A palm-sized, apricot octopus with ink-blue freckles putters through a tank of rippled cream sand, sea-glass pebbles, and one crooked ceramic arch, beneath light that shimmers like sun through a kitchen window. It spends its afternoons arranging pebbles into elaborate spirals, then moves the innermost stone somewhere ridiculous and settles under the arch to contemplate the improvement.
